title: Very thin, not very sturdy, don't like the cuff
text:
Very thin, not very sturdy, don't like the cuff. Well, I cannot recommend these for much of anything. I'd say you could do a small gift in them, but they are not sturdy enough to use like a regular Christmas stocking.

I love buffalo check, and had high hopes for these. Well, it's a big ol' nope from me.

These are made from a thin felt.
The front collar is not even folded over, just attached with a regular seam. It too is a brushed felt. It does go all the way around the sock, but just one layer. There is a thin stabilizer fabric on the inside of the collar.
There is a piece of red satin ribbon inside for the hanger. The inside of the checked part of the sock is completely unlined. Very thin.

The only thing I would use these for is maybe tuck some spatulas or rubber scrapers inside, and a packet of cookie mix. Other than that, they are pretty useless.

The toe isn't even cut like a regular sock...it is quite a bit shorter, and looks "off". I love Christmas socks and decorate with them. But these do not get a place on my walls...they are cut badly, made with cheap materials and are just odd. Hard pass, and I cannot recommend them.
